parsed.why: No criminalisation or documented trans targeting, but state tolerates only discreet LGBTI life; public immodesty or advocacy can draw official retribution; no protections and societal discrimination.
No explicit ban, yet vagrancy law, conversion practices, police raids and collective detention, custody sexual violence, and no working remedy make state-tolerated targeting severe.
No criminalisation and a 2018 equality guarantee, but the record is thin, with no trans-specific enforcement, facility, or document evidence; societal stigma only.
Strong court and self-ID protections plus active community, but documented public harassment, political hate speech and implementation gaps keep it below safer tiers.
Same-sex acts legal, but public-decency penalty, no protections, documented anti-LGBT assaults, police inaction and victim-blaming, with trans-feminine people specifically targeted.
